_about: 2-Methoxyethanol (1) + 2-Propanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-methoxyethanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-methoxyethanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: E. Lladosa, J. B. Monton, M. Burguet, R. Munoz, Effect of pressure and the capability of 2-methoxyethanol as a solvent in the behaviour of a diisopropyl ether isopropyl alcohol azeotropic mixture, Fluid Phase Equilib. 262 (2007) 271-279
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 16, 17. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0032. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.15 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
